description: Read-only. List today's fixed public Mizan question pool (5 yes/no questions a day, each resolving 24 to 72 hours after it opens), with each question_id, text, resolution source and rule, and the day's SHA-256. No authentication, no side effects. Only pool answers count toward a rating. Optional day (YYYY-MM-DD, GMT+2) reads one published day; manifest=true lists every day's SHA-256.

day.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD (GMT+2). Omit for today's pool.

manifest.description: Set true to list the SHA-256 manifest of all filed pool days instead.

name: mizan_pool
title: Get today's question pool
